There's no going back.

2. The price during orthodontic treatment is: if you think it's 999 baht for the first two months and then 1499 baht continuously, don't. At the start of treatment, you need to have scaling, fillings, etc.

If you have more than 1499 baht a month, you're fine, but if you only have enough for the monthly orthodontic cost, it might be difficult.
3. We paid about 3000 baht for a retainer and 2000 baht for removing the braces. We didn't get any freebies as advertised. The staff
didn't inform us of this, and we didn't ask. (Prepare about 5000 baht++ for braces removal.)

4. The queuing system is disorganized. There are long waits, but we've never complained. You just have to wait according to the system. The staff said that the doctor said it would be according to the queue, and they wanted us to go to the back. We said that was okay, but if it was really according to the queue, our turn was at 11:30 AM, so we should have been treated at 11:30 AM (if we wanted to follow the queue like the doctor said). In the end, we got treated right away, but I'm confused because:
When we went according to the queue, we waited a long time, haha. We never complained, but when we went early,
they wanted to follow the queue (which if that were the case, we should have been treated exactly at 11:30 AM, right?). The logic is very strange. Anyone who goes there has to wait in line. Allow at least an hour or more (long wait, the procedure itself is quick).

5. On the day of the braces removal, the doctor applied the glue terribly. Saliva and bits flew into my nose and face, causing me to choke and cough until my throat hurt. Like, what the heck? But I didn't care because it hurt so much. I just didn't understand.
